blocks.html: Łukasz has spent close to fifteen years in tech across the EMEA and U.S. markets. He’s worked with a range of tech services and SaaS providers, including a DevOps platform that launched Poland’s first CI/CD tool, now used by over 2,000 companies worldwide. He has led operations, GTM strategies, and cross-functional teams for tech providers working with Fortune 500s and SMB startups through key growth phases. As part of insightify.io, he focuses on strategy, client engagement & bridging business needs with scalable data solutions.
